origin: ts.mbt — fuzz-mangle finding: property write into an observed object
what: `snapshot` reaches JSON.stringify, so its own keys stay reserved. What is WRITTEN into it had no flow edge at all: names arriving through a spread (`alpha` / `beta` / `gamma`) were renamed and deleted, and keys that exist only in the written literal (`revision`, `retries`, `tag`) had nothing else in the bundle to keep them. The string-literal computed write is the spelling that breaks — the dotted form is covered by the PropReceiver use recorded for the target — so both are here, plus a write one level down so the target root has to be walked.
